title: Should Schools Start Later?
text:
Many people believe that schools should start later in the morning. In a persuasive essay, the writer tries to convince the reader that an idea is true. A strong essay uses clear reasons and good evidence. For example, one writer might explain that teenagers need more sleep.

However, a persuasive essay must also consider the other side. The writer can admit that a later start may cause problems for working parents. By answering these concerns, the writer makes the argument more believable. This is why good essays often end with a strong conclusion.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what do many people believe?
options: Schools should start later in the morning
Schools should close earlier in the day

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can the writer admit?
options: A later start may cause problems for working parents
Teachers do not like the idea

questions.text: Why does the writer answer the concerns of people who disagree?
options: To make the argument more believable
To show that the other side is always wrong

questions.text: Based on the passage, what makes a persuasive essay stronger?
options: It considers opposing views and answers them

vocabulary.definition: trying to make people agree with an idea
facts or examples that show something is true
the final part of an essay that sums up the main points

paragraph_translations: Muchas personas creen que las escuelas deberían empezar más tarde por la mañana. En un ensayo persuasivo, el escritor intenta convencer al lector de que una idea es verdadera. Un ensayo sólido usa razones claras y buenas pruebas. Por ejemplo, un escritor podría explicar que los adolescentes necesitan dormir más.

Sin embargo, un ensayo persuasivo también debe considerar la otra postura. El escritor puede admitir que un inicio más tarde puede causar problemas a los padres que trabajan. Al responder a estas preocupaciones, el escritor hace que el argumento sea más creíble. Por eso los buenos ensayos suelen terminar con una conclusión fuerte y clara.
